observation_indicators.observable_fil: Magbigay ng factual na handover na may oras at hilinging kumpirmahin ng tatanggap ang susunod na hakbang.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Deliver a timed, factual handover and invite the receiving worker to confirm the next action.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Nagdadagdag ng hinulaang diagnosis, kinakaligtaan ang oras o ginawa, o ibinabahagi ang detalye sa labas ng handover.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Adds a guessed diagnosis, leaves out the time or actions, or shares identifiable details outside the care handover.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Nagha-handover ayon sa ayos ng job aid, may oras, nakita at ginawa, walang hinulaang diagnosis, at hinihiling sa tatanggap na kumpirmahin ang susunod na hakbang, nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Hands over in the job aid order with times, observed facts and actions, gives no guessed diagnosis, and asks the receiver to confirm the next action, without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Naibibigay ang facts, pero kailangan ng paalala para isama ang oras o hilinging kumpirmahin ang susunod na hakbang.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Gives the facts, but needs a prompt to include the times or to ask the receiver to confirm the next action.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Nagdadagdag ng hinulaang diagnosis, kinakaligtaan ang oras o ginawa, o ibinabahagi ang detalye sa labas ng handover.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Adds a guessed diagnosis, leaves out the time or actions, or shares identifiable details outside the care handover.
